content:
## Agent CLI: MCP delivery (Claude Code)

This run uses the `claude-code` command. S.E.E. keeps the project's MCP configuration in `claude-mcp.json` inside the project's `.s_e_e` folder and passes that file to Claude Code with `--mcp-config`. Claude Code ignores MCP settings passed only through the child environment.
